metadata.source_plan_name: RetailManager V2 RC1 – Guided Smoke Test

suite.name: RetailManager V2 RC1 – Guided Smoke Test

test_cases.title: Login with valid phone number via WhatsApp OTP
test_cases.description: Verify a retailer can log in using their registered phone number and receive an OTP via WhatsApp.
test_cases.preconditions: App is installed. Retailer has a registered phone number. WhatsApp is reachable.
test_cases.expected_result: Retailer is authenticated and lands on the Dashboard.

steps.action: Open the RetailManager app on the device.
steps.expected: Splash screen appears, then the Login screen loads.

steps.action: Enter a registered retailer phone number in the Phone Number field.
steps.expected: Phone number is accepted and formatted correctly (e.g., +91XXXXXXXXXX).

steps.action: Tap 'Send OTP'.
steps.expected: App displays 'OTP sent to your WhatsApp' confirmation message. OTP input field appears.

steps.action: Check WhatsApp on the device and note the 6-digit OTP received.
steps.expected: A WhatsApp message from the system arrives within 30 seconds containing a 6-digit OTP.

steps.action: Enter the OTP into the OTP field.
steps.expected: Each digit is accepted. The field shows the entered OTP masked or visible.

steps.action: Tap 'Verify OTP'.
steps.expected: Authentication succeeds. App navigates to the Dashboard screen.

test_cases.title: Login fails with incorrect OTP
test_cases.description: Verify the app rejects an incorrect OTP and shows an actionable error.
test_cases.preconditions: OTP has been sent to the retailer's phone.
test_cases.expected_result: Login is denied. Error message is displayed. Retailer remains on the OTP screen.

steps.action: On the OTP entry screen, enter an intentionally incorrect 6-digit OTP (e.g., 000000).
steps.expected: OTP field accepts the entry.

steps.action: Tap 'Verify OTP'.
steps.expected: App displays an error such as 'Invalid OTP. Please try again.' Retailer stays on the OTP screen.

steps.action: Verify the OTP field is cleared or editable for a retry.
steps.expected: Retailer can re-enter the correct OTP without restarting the flow.

test_cases.title: Dashboard loads with key metrics after login
test_cases.description: Verify the Dashboard displays today's sales summary, inventory alerts, and navigation correctly.
test_cases.preconditions: Retailer is logged in. At least one sale exists for today.
test_cases.expected_result: Dashboard renders all key metric cards without errors or blank states.

steps.action: Observe the Dashboard screen immediately after login.
steps.expected: Dashboard loads within 3 seconds. No loading spinners remain after initial load.

steps.action: Verify the Today's Sales card is visible and shows a numeric value.
steps.expected: Today's Sales card displays a currency amount (e.g., ₹0.00 if no sales, or actual total).

steps.action: Verify the Total Products, Low Stock, and Out of Stock cards are visible.
steps.expected: Each metric card displays a number. Low Stock and Out of Stock counts are non-negative integers.

steps.action: Tap each bottom navigation item (Sales, Products, Reports, Settings).
steps.expected: Each tap navigates to the correct screen without crash or blank page.

steps.action: Return to the Dashboard using the Home/Dashboard nav item.
steps.expected: Dashboard re-renders correctly with the same data.

test_cases.title: Add a new product with all required fields
test_cases.description: Verify a retailer can add a product and it appears in the product list.
test_cases.preconditions: Retailer is logged in. At least one category exists.
test_cases.expected_result: Product is created and visible in the Products list with correct details.

steps.action: Navigate to Products from the bottom navigation or side menu.
steps.expected: Products list screen opens. Existing products are listed or empty state is shown.

steps.action: Tap the '+' or 'Add Product' button.
steps.expected: Add Product form opens with empty fields.

steps.action: Enter Product Name: 'Smoke Test Biscuit Pack 200g'.
steps.expected: Name field accepts the text.

steps.action: Enter SKU: 'SKU-SMOKE-001'. Enter Selling Price: 25. Enter Cost Price: 18. Enter Opening Stock: 100.
steps.expected: All fields accept the values. Currency fields show formatted numbers.

steps.action: Select a Category from the dropdown (e.g., 'Snacks' or any available category).
steps.expected: Category is selected and shown in the field.

steps.action: Tap 'Save' or 'Add Product'.
steps.expected: Success toast or confirmation appears. Product 'Smoke Test Biscuit Pack 200g' appears in the Products list.

steps.action: Search for 'Smoke Test Biscuit' in the Products search bar.
steps.expected: The newly added product appears in search results with correct name, SKU, price, and stock.

test_cases.title: Edit an existing product's selling price
test_cases.description: Verify a retailer can update a product's selling price and the change persists.
test_cases.preconditions: Product 'Smoke Test Biscuit Pack 200g' (SKU-SMOKE-001) exists from RM-004.
test_cases.expected_result: Selling price is updated to the new value and reflected in the product list.

steps.action: Navigate to Products and find 'Smoke Test Biscuit Pack 200g'.
steps.expected: Product is visible in the list.

steps.action: Tap the product to open its detail view, then tap 'Edit'.
steps.expected: Edit Product form opens pre-filled with the existing product details.

steps.action: Change the Selling Price from 25 to 28.
steps.expected: Price field updates to 28.

steps.action: Tap 'Save'.
steps.expected: Success confirmation appears. Product list shows the updated price of ₹28.

test_cases.title: Search and filter products by category
test_cases.description: Verify the product search and category filter return correct results.
test_cases.preconditions: At least 5 products exist across at least 2 categories.
test_cases.expected_result: Search and filter results show only matching products.

steps.action: Navigate to Products.
steps.expected: Products list loads.

steps.action: Type 'Smoke' in the search bar.
steps.expected: Only products containing 'Smoke' in their name appear in the list.

steps.action: Clear the search and apply a category filter (tap the filter icon and select a category).
steps.expected: Only products belonging to the selected category are displayed.

steps.action: Clear the category filter.
steps.expected: All products are visible again.

test_cases.title: Add a new supplier

test_cases.title: Create a new sale – cash payment
test_cases.description: Verify a retailer can create a sale, add products, and complete it with cash payment.
test_cases.preconditions: Retailer is logged in. At least one product with stock > 0 exists. Customer 'Raj Sharma' exists.
test_cases.expected_result: Sale is completed, invoice is generated, and stock is reduced.

steps.action: Navigate to Sales and tap 'New Sale' or the '+' button.
steps.expected: New Sale screen opens with an empty cart.

steps.action: Search for 'Smoke Test Biscuit' in the product search bar.
steps.expected: Product appears in search results.

steps.action: Tap the product to add it to the cart. Set quantity to 3.
steps.expected: Product is added to the cart with quantity 3. Line total shows ₹84 (3 × ₹28).

steps.action: Tap 'Select Customer' and choose 'Raj Sharma'.
steps.expected: Customer is linked to the sale. Customer name appears in the sale header.

steps.action: Review the order total. Verify subtotal and grand total are shown.
steps.expected: Subtotal = ₹84. If GST is configured (e.g. 18% from RM-031), tax line = ₹15.12 and grand total = ₹99.12. If no tax is configured, grand total = ₹84. The grand total field must show a numeric ₹ value — a blank, zero, or error is a failure.
steps.notes: Tax value depends on the GST rate set in Settings (RM-031). Note the actual grand total displayed for use in RM-022.

steps.action: Select 'Cash' as the payment method.
steps.expected: Cash payment option is selected. Amount Tendered field appears.

steps.action: Enter Amount Tendered: 100. Tap 'Complete Sale'.
steps.expected: Sale is completed. Change due (₹16) is shown. Invoice/receipt screen appears.

steps.action: Navigate back to Products and check the stock of 'Smoke Test Biscuit Pack 200g'.
steps.expected: Stock has decreased by 3 (from 100 to 97).

test_cases.title: Create a sale with UPI payment
test_cases.description: Verify a sale can be completed with UPI as the payment method.
test_cases.preconditions: Retailer is logged in. Product with stock > 0 exists.
test_cases.expected_result: Sale is saved with UPI payment method recorded.

steps.action: Navigate to Sales and tap 'New Sale'. Search for 'Smoke Test Biscuit Pack 200g' and add it to the cart with quantity 2.
steps.expected: Product is added to the cart. Line total shows ₹56 (2 × ₹28). Cart grand total is ₹56 (plus tax if configured).

steps.action: Select 'UPI' as the payment method.
steps.expected: UPI option is selected. UPI Reference field may appear.

steps.action: Enter a UPI Reference number (e.g., 'UPI123456789').
steps.expected: Reference is accepted.

steps.action: Tap 'Complete Sale'.
steps.expected: Sale is saved. Invoice shows payment method as UPI with the reference number.

test_cases.title: Apply a discount on a sale
test_cases.description: Verify the retailer can apply a percentage or flat discount to a sale.
test_cases.preconditions: A new sale is in progress with at least one product in the cart.
test_cases.expected_result: Discount is applied and the grand total is reduced correctly.

steps.action: Start a new sale and add 'Smoke Test Biscuit Pack 200g' with quantity 5 (total ₹140).
steps.expected: Cart shows ₹140 subtotal.

steps.action: Tap the Discount field or 'Add Discount' option. Enter 10% discount.
steps.expected: Discount of ₹14 is calculated and shown. Grand total updates to ₹126.

steps.action: Complete the sale with Cash payment.
steps.expected: Invoice shows the discount line item and the discounted total.

test_cases.title: View and print a sale invoice
test_cases.description: Verify the retailer can view an invoice and initiate print/share after a sale.
test_cases.preconditions: At least one completed sale exists.
test_cases.expected_result: Invoice displays correctly and print/share option is accessible.

steps.action: Navigate to Sales History / All Sales.
steps.expected: List of past sales is displayed with date and amount.

steps.action: Tap on the most recent completed sale.
steps.expected: Sale detail/invoice screen opens showing all line items, totals, and payment method.

steps.action: Tap 'Print' or 'Share Invoice'.
steps.expected: Print dialog or share sheet appears. The invoice is formatted for the selected paper size (e.g., 80mm thermal).

test_cases.title: Create a purchase order from a supplier
test_cases.description: Verify a retailer can create a purchase order linked to a supplier.
test_cases.preconditions: Supplier 'Sunrise Distributors' exists. At least one product exists.
test_cases.expected_result: Purchase order is created with pending status and linked to the supplier.

steps.action: Navigate to Purchases from the menu.
steps.expected: Purchases list screen opens.

steps.action: Tap 'New Purchase' or '+'.
steps.expected: New Purchase form opens.

steps.action: Select Supplier: 'Sunrise Distributors'.
steps.expected: Supplier is linked to the purchase order.

steps.action: Add 'Smoke Test Biscuit Pack 200g' with quantity 50 and purchase price ₹18.
steps.expected: Line item is added. Total shows ₹900.

steps.action: Set Invoice Date to today's date.
steps.expected: Date is set correctly.

steps.action: Tap 'Save Purchase'.
steps.expected: Purchase order is saved with 'Pending' or 'Ordered' status. It appears in the Purchases list.

test_cases.title: Receive goods against a purchase order
test_cases.description: Verify that receiving goods against a PO updates the inventory stock.
test_cases.preconditions: A pending purchase order exists from RM-014.
test_cases.expected_result: PO status changes to Received and product stock increases.

steps.action: Navigate to Purchases and open the pending PO created in RM-014.
steps.expected: PO detail screen shows status as Pending/Ordered.

steps.action: Tap 'Receive Goods' or 'Mark as Received'.
steps.expected: Receive Goods confirmation appears or status updates directly.

steps.action: Confirm the receipt.
steps.expected: PO status changes to 'Received'. Success message is shown.

steps.action: Navigate to Products and check the stock of 'Smoke Test Biscuit Pack 200g'.
steps.expected: Stock has increased by 50 (reflects the received quantity).

test_cases.title: View purchase history with supplier filter
test_cases.description: Verify the retailer can filter purchase history by supplier.
test_cases.preconditions: At least 2 purchase orders exist, one from 'Sunrise Distributors'.
test_cases.expected_result: Filter returns only purchases from the selected supplier.

steps.action: Navigate to Purchases.
steps.expected: All purchase orders are listed.

steps.action: Apply the Supplier filter and select 'Sunrise Distributors'.
steps.expected: Only purchases from 'Sunrise Distributors' appear in the list.

steps.action: Clear the filter.
steps.expected: All purchases are shown again.

test_cases.title: View inventory stock levels
test_cases.description: Verify the Inventory screen shows correct stock levels for all products.
test_cases.preconditions: Multiple products exist with varying stock quantities.
test_cases.expected_result: Inventory list shows each product's current stock, reorder level, and status.

steps.action: Navigate to Inventory from the menu.
steps.expected: Inventory list opens showing all products.

steps.action: Verify 'Smoke Test Biscuit Pack 200g' is listed with its current stock.
steps.expected: Product appears with stock count consistent with Sales and Purchase actions performed in earlier tests.

steps.action: Look for any Low Stock or Out of Stock badges/indicators.
steps.expected: Products with stock below reorder level show a warning indicator. Out-of-stock products show an alert.

test_cases.title: Perform a manual stock adjustment
test_cases.description: Verify the retailer can manually adjust stock for a product (e.g., damage write-off).
test_cases.preconditions: Product with stock > 5 exists.
test_cases.expected_result: Stock quantity is updated after the adjustment.

steps.action: Navigate to Inventory and find 'Smoke Test Biscuit Pack 200g'.
steps.expected: Product is listed.

steps.action: Tap 'Adjust Stock' or the edit icon for the product.
steps.expected: Stock Adjustment form opens showing current stock.

steps.action: Set adjustment type to 'Decrease' (damage/loss) and enter quantity 2. Add reason: 'Damaged in storage'.
steps.expected: Form accepts the adjustment values.

steps.action: Tap 'Save Adjustment'.
steps.expected: Success message appears. Product stock decreases by 2. Adjustment is logged in the stock history.

test_cases.title: Low stock alert is visible for products below reorder level
test_cases.description: Verify products below the reorder level trigger a visible low stock alert.
test_cases.preconditions: At least one product has stock below its reorder level.
test_cases.expected_result: Low stock alert is shown in Inventory and Dashboard.

steps.action: Navigate to Products. Find 'Smoke Test Biscuit Pack 200g' (SKU-SMOKE-001). Tap it to open the detail view, then tap 'Edit'. Locate the 'Reorder Level' field and enter 200. Tap 'Save'.
steps.expected: Edit form saves successfully. Reorder level is now 200, which is higher than the current stock quantity (which is less than 200 after prior test actions).
steps.notes: If the Reorder Level field is not in the product edit form, check Inventory settings for the product instead.

steps.action: Navigate to Inventory.
steps.expected: The product shows a 'Low Stock' badge or warning.

steps.action: Navigate to the Dashboard.
steps.expected: The Low Stock count card on the Dashboard reflects at least 1 product.

test_cases.title: Add an expense record
test_cases.description: Verify a retailer can record a business expense.
test_cases.preconditions: Retailer is logged in. At least one expense category exists.
test_cases.expected_result: Expense is saved and visible in the Expenses list.

steps.action: Navigate to Expenses from the menu.
steps.expected: Expenses list opens.

steps.action: Tap 'Add Expense'.
steps.expected: Add Expense form opens.

steps.action: Enter Amount: 500. Select Category: 'Electricity' (or any available). Add Description: 'Monthly electricity bill'. Set Date to today.
steps.expected: All fields accept the values.

steps.action: Tap 'Save'.
steps.expected: Expense is saved. It appears in the Expenses list with today's date and ₹500.

test_cases.title: View expenses for the current month
test_cases.description: Verify the expenses list can be filtered by the current month.
test_cases.preconditions: At least one expense exists for the current month.
test_cases.expected_result: Only current-month expenses are shown when the month filter is applied.

steps.action: Navigate to Expenses and apply the current month date filter.
steps.expected: Filter is applied and the list updates.

steps.action: Verify the expense added in RM-020 appears in the filtered list.
steps.expected: The ₹500 electricity expense is visible with today's date.

steps.action: Verify the total expenses amount shown matches the sum of visible entries.
steps.expected: If only the RM-020 expense has been entered this month, the total displays ₹500.00. If additional expenses exist, the total equals the sum of all listed entries. The displayed total must match the manual sum of visible rows — a discrepancy of any amount is a failure.

test_cases.title: Generate Today's Sales Report
test_cases.description: Verify the Sales Report for today generates with accurate totals.
test_cases.preconditions: At least 2 sales exist for today (from RM-010, RM-011, RM-012).
test_cases.expected_result: Sales report shows today's transactions with correct totals.

steps.action: Navigate to Reports.
steps.expected: Reports screen loads with report type options.

steps.action: Select 'Sales Report'. Set date range to Today.
steps.expected: Report parameters are set.

steps.action: Tap 'Generate' or 'View Report'.
steps.expected: Report loads showing each sale, payment method breakdown, and a grand total.

steps.action: Verify the grand total matches the sum of sales created during this smoke test session.
steps.expected: Grand total = sum of: RM-010 grand total (noted during execution) + RM-011 sale amount (₹56 or ₹56 + tax) + RM-012 discounted total (₹126 or ₹126 + tax). Each individual sale must appear as a separate line in the report. The report total must equal the arithmetic sum of all listed sales — a mismatch of any amount is a failure.
steps.notes: Tester must have recorded the grand total from RM-010 Step 5 to perform this verification.

test_cases.title: Generate Inventory / Stock Report
test_cases.description: Verify the Inventory Report shows current stock value and quantity.
test_cases.preconditions: Products exist with stock.
test_cases.expected_result: Inventory report lists all products with current quantity and value.

steps.action: Navigate to Reports and select 'Inventory Report' or 'Stock Report'.
steps.expected: Report type is selected.

steps.action: Tap 'Generate Report'.
steps.expected: Report shows a table of products with SKU, name, quantity on hand, cost price, and total value.

steps.action: Verify 'Smoke Test Biscuit Pack 200g' appears with the correct current stock.
steps.expected: Product row shows the stock level consistent with previous test actions.

test_cases.title: Generate Profit and Loss Report
test_cases.description: Verify the P&L Report calculates gross profit correctly.
test_cases.preconditions: Sales and purchases exist for the current month.
test_cases.expected_result: P&L report shows revenue, cost of goods, gross profit, and expenses.

steps.action: Navigate to Reports and select 'Profit & Loss' or 'P&L Report'.
steps.expected: Report type is selected.

steps.action: Set the date range to the current month and tap 'Generate'.
steps.expected: P&L report loads.

steps.action: Verify that Revenue, COGS, Gross Profit, Expenses, and Net Profit rows are present.
steps.expected: All financial rows are present. Net Profit = Gross Profit − Expenses.

test_cases.title: Export a report to PDF or CSV
test_cases.description: Verify the retailer can export a generated report.
test_cases.preconditions: A Sales Report has been generated.
test_cases.expected_result: Report is exported and the file is accessible.

steps.action: Navigate to Reports. Select 'Sales Report'. Set the date range to Today. Tap 'Generate' or 'View Report'. Wait for the report to finish loading.
steps.expected: Sales Report is displayed on screen showing today's transactions. No loading spinner remains. No error message is shown.

steps.action: Tap the Export button (PDF or CSV option).
steps.expected: Export options appear.

steps.action: Select PDF export.
steps.expected: PDF is generated and the device's share/download dialog appears. File can be saved or shared.

test_cases.title: View current subscription plan details
test_cases.description: Verify the retailer can see their active subscription plan, expiry date, and features.
test_cases.preconditions: Retailer has an active subscription.
test_cases.expected_result: Subscription screen shows correct plan name, expiry date, and feature list.

steps.action: Navigate to Settings > Subscription or the Subscription screen from the menu.
steps.expected: Subscription screen opens.

steps.action: Verify the current plan name (e.g., 'Basic', 'Pro', 'Enterprise') is displayed.
steps.expected: Plan name is clearly labeled.

steps.action: Verify the subscription expiry date is shown.
steps.expected: A future expiry date is displayed (or 'Lifetime' for lifetime plans).

steps.action: Review the features listed under the current plan.
steps.expected: Feature list matches the plan's documented capabilities.

test_cases.title: Initiate a subscription upgrade via Razorpay
test_cases.description: Verify the subscription upgrade flow initiates a Razorpay payment correctly.
test_cases.preconditions: Retailer is on the Basic plan. Internet connectivity is active.
test_cases.expected_result: Razorpay payment sheet opens with the correct amount for the selected plan.

steps.action: Navigate to the Subscription screen and tap 'Upgrade Plan' or 'View Plans'.
steps.expected: Plan selection screen shows available upgrade options with pricing.

steps.action: Select the 'Pro' plan (or the next tier above current).
steps.expected: Plan details and price are highlighted.

steps.action: Tap 'Subscribe' or 'Upgrade Now'.
steps.expected: The app calls the backend to create a Razorpay order. Razorpay payment sheet opens within 5 seconds.

steps.action: Verify the Razorpay sheet shows the correct amount matching the selected plan price.
steps.expected: Amount in Razorpay equals the displayed plan price. Business name and description are correct.
steps.notes: Do NOT complete the payment in smoke test. Only verify the sheet opens correctly.

steps.action: Dismiss the Razorpay payment sheet (tap Back or Close).
steps.expected: Payment sheet closes. User returns to the plan selection screen without error.

test_cases.title: Complete a Razorpay test payment for subscription
test_cases.description: Verify the end-to-end Razorpay payment flow and post-payment subscription activation.
test_cases.preconditions: Razorpay test mode is active. Test card details are available. Retailer is on a plan eligible for upgrade.
test_cases.expected_result: Payment succeeds and subscription is activated/upgraded immediately.

steps.action: Navigate to Subscription and initiate an upgrade (as in RM-027 steps 1–3).
steps.expected: Razorpay payment sheet opens.

steps.action: Select 'Card' payment method in Razorpay. Enter test card: 4111 1111 1111 1111, Expiry: 12/26, CVV: 123.
steps.expected: Card details are accepted.

steps.action: Tap 'Pay' in the Razorpay sheet.
steps.expected: Payment is processed. Razorpay shows a success screen.

steps.action: Return to the RetailManager app and observe the Subscription screen.
steps.expected: Subscription status updates to the new plan immediately (within 10 seconds). Success toast is shown.

steps.action: Verify the new plan name and updated expiry date are shown.
steps.expected: Plan name reflects the upgraded tier. Expiry date is in the future.

test_cases.title: Verify payment failure is handled gracefully
test_cases.description: Verify that a failed Razorpay payment does not change the subscription status.
test_cases.preconditions: Retailer is on a plan eligible for upgrade. Razorpay test mode active.
test_cases.expected_result: On payment failure, subscription remains unchanged and an error is shown.

steps.action: Navigate to Subscription and initiate an upgrade.
steps.expected: Razorpay payment sheet opens.

steps.action: In Razorpay, use the test failure card: 4000 0000 0000 0002.
steps.expected: Card is entered.

steps.action: Tap 'Pay'.
steps.expected: Razorpay shows a payment failed message.

steps.action: Return to RetailManager and check the Subscription screen.
steps.expected: Subscription plan is unchanged. An error or informational message is shown. No partial state is visible.

test_cases.title: Update business information in Settings
test_cases.description: Verify the retailer can update their business name, address, and GST number.
test_cases.preconditions: Retailer is logged in.
test_cases.expected_result: Business information is saved and reflected in invoices.

steps.action: Navigate to Settings > Business Information (or Profile Settings).
steps.expected: Business info form opens with current values.

steps.action: Update Business Name to 'Smoke Test Retail Store'. Update Address to '45 Test Street, Test City - 560001'. Update GSTIN to '29TESTG1234F1Z5'.
steps.expected: Fields accept the updated values.

steps.action: Tap 'Save'.
steps.expected: Success message appears. Business info is updated.

steps.action: Create a new sale and view the invoice.
steps.expected: Invoice header shows the updated business name and address.

test_cases.title: Configure tax settings (GST rate)
test_cases.description: Verify the retailer can configure the default tax/GST rate.
test_cases.preconditions: Retailer is in Settings.
test_cases.expected_result: Tax rate is saved and applied to new sales.

steps.action: Navigate to Settings > Tax Settings.
steps.expected: Tax Settings screen opens.

steps.action: Set the default GST rate to 18%. Tap 'Save'.
steps.expected: GST rate is saved. Confirmation is shown.

steps.action: Create a new sale with one product priced at ₹100. Observe the tax line on the invoice.
steps.expected: Tax line shows 18% = ₹18. Grand total = ₹118.

test_cases.title: Back up data to cloud / local storage
test_cases.description: Verify the retailer can initiate a data backup successfully.
test_cases.preconditions: Retailer is logged in. Storage permission granted (if applicable).
test_cases.expected_result: Backup completes successfully and a confirmation with timestamp is shown.

steps.action: Navigate to Settings > Backup & Restore.
steps.expected: Backup & Restore screen opens showing last backup timestamp.

steps.action: Tap 'Backup Now'.
steps.expected: Backup progress indicator appears.

steps.action: Wait for the backup to complete.
steps.expected: Success message appears: 'Backup completed successfully'. The last backup timestamp updates to the current date and time.

test_cases.title: Restore data from a backup
test_cases.description: Verify the retailer can restore data from the most recent backup.
test_cases.preconditions: At least one backup exists (from RM-032).
test_cases.expected_result: Data is restored from the backup and app data is consistent.

steps.action: Navigate to Settings > Backup & Restore.
steps.expected: The most recent backup is listed with its timestamp.

steps.action: Tap 'Restore' next to the most recent backup.
steps.expected: A confirmation dialog appears warning that current data may be overwritten.

steps.action: Confirm the restore.
steps.expected: Restore progress is shown. Upon completion, a success message appears.

steps.action: Navigate to Products and verify the product list matches the backed-up state.
steps.expected: 'Smoke Test Biscuit Pack 200g' is still present with its correct data.

test_cases.title: Sales session with multiple payment modes (split payment)
test_cases.description: Verify a sale can be completed using split payment (partial cash + partial UPI).
test_cases.preconditions: Retailer is logged in. Product with stock > 0 exists. Split payment feature is enabled in the app (verify in Settings before executing this case — if the feature is disabled or not present, mark this case as Blocked with reason 'Feature not available in current build').
test_cases.expected_result: Sale records both payment amounts and the invoice shows split payment breakdown.

steps.action: Start a new sale and add a product totalling ₹200.
steps.expected: Cart shows ₹200 grand total.

steps.action: Select 'Split Payment' as the payment method.
steps.expected: Split payment mode opens with two or more amount fields for different payment types.

steps.action: Enter ₹100 for Cash and ₹100 for UPI.
steps.expected: Total of both amounts equals ₹200 (the grand total).

steps.action: Tap 'Complete Sale'.
steps.expected: Sale is saved. Invoice shows ₹100 Cash and ₹100 UPI breakdown.

test_cases.title: Product barcode scan adds item to sale cart
test_cases.description: Verify scanning a product barcode adds it to the sale cart correctly.
test_cases.preconditions: A product with a barcode/SKU exists and has stock. Camera permission is granted.
test_cases.expected_result: Scanned product is added to the cart automatically.

steps.action: Start a new sale.
steps.expected: New Sale cart opens.

steps.action: Tap the barcode scanner icon in the product search area.
steps.expected: Camera opens in barcode scanning mode.

steps.action: Scan the barcode of a product (or enter the SKU manually if a physical barcode is unavailable).
steps.expected: Product is identified. Its name and price appear.

steps.action: Confirm adding the product to the cart.
steps.expected: Product is added to the cart with quantity 1 and correct price.

test_cases.title: Customer credit/due balance is tracked after a credit sale
test_cases.description: Verify that a sale on credit records a due balance against the customer.
test_cases.preconditions: Customer 'Raj Sharma' exists. Credit sale feature is available.
test_cases.expected_result: Customer's outstanding balance is updated after a credit sale.

steps.action: Start a new sale, add a product totalling ₹150, and select customer 'Raj Sharma'.
steps.expected: Customer is linked to the sale.

steps.action: Select 'Credit' or 'Due' as the payment method.
steps.expected: Credit payment is selected. No amount is collected.

steps.action: Complete the sale.
steps.expected: Sale is recorded as a credit sale. Invoice shows 'Due: ₹150'.

steps.action: Navigate to Customers > 'Raj Sharma' > Outstanding Balance.
steps.expected: Balance shows ₹150 due.

test_cases.title: Generate Customers Outstanding Report
test_cases.description: Verify the outstanding balance report lists all customers with pending dues.
test_cases.preconditions: At least one customer has an outstanding balance (from RM-036).
test_cases.expected_result: Outstanding report lists customers with correct due amounts.

steps.action: Navigate to Reports and select 'Customers Outstanding' or 'Dues Report'.
steps.expected: Report type is selected.

steps.action: Generate the report.
steps.expected: Report lists all customers with a non-zero outstanding balance.

steps.action: Verify 'Raj Sharma' appears with a due amount of ₹150.
steps.expected: Customer row shows ₹150 outstanding.

test_cases.title: Multi-user: verify role-based access for staff
test_cases.description: Verify that a staff user cannot access admin-only features (e.g., Reports, Settings).
test_cases.preconditions: Retailer is logged in as admin. A staff user account has been created under this business and the staff member's registered phone number is known (required to complete OTP login in Step 1).
test_cases.expected_result: Staff user cannot access restricted sections. Appropriate access-denied message is shown.

steps.action: Log out of the admin account and log in with a staff user account.
steps.expected: Staff user is authenticated and lands on the Dashboard.

steps.action: Attempt to navigate to Reports.
steps.expected: Reports section is either hidden from the menu or shows 'Access Denied / Insufficient Permissions'.

steps.action: Attempt to navigate to Settings.
steps.expected: Settings is restricted. Staff user can only access allowed settings (e.g., profile).

steps.action: Verify the staff user can create a sale normally.
steps.expected: New Sale flow works without restriction for staff users.

test_cases.title: App functions correctly while offline (no network)
test_cases.description: Verify core sale creation functions offline and syncs when connectivity is restored.
test_cases.preconditions: App is installed with data preloaded. Device can have network toggled off.
test_cases.expected_result: Sale is created offline and synced to the server when network is restored.

steps.action: Disable Wi-Fi and mobile data on the device (Airplane mode or toggle network off).
steps.expected: Device has no internet connectivity.

steps.action: Open RetailManager and navigate to Sales.
steps.expected: App opens without crash. An offline indicator may appear.

steps.action: Create a new sale with an existing product and complete it with cash payment.
steps.expected: Sale is saved locally. Confirmation is shown. An 'Offline / Pending Sync' indicator is visible on the sale.

steps.action: Re-enable network connectivity.
steps.expected: App detects the network and syncs the offline sale to the server. The sync indicator disappears.

steps.action: Check the sales history.
steps.expected: The offline sale now appears in the synced list without duplication.

test_cases.title: First-time retailer onboarding and account creation
test_cases.description: Verify a new retailer can complete the first-launch onboarding flow: register a phone number, set up their business profile, and reach a usable app state.
test_cases.preconditions: A fresh device or app installation with no existing account. The phone number being registered has NOT been used before. Internet connectivity is active.
test_cases.expected_result: New retailer account is created, business profile is configured, and the retailer lands on the Dashboard ready to use the app.

steps.action: Install and open RetailManager for the first time (or clear app data to simulate a fresh install).
steps.expected: App launches to a Welcome or Sign Up screen — not the Dashboard. No pre-filled credentials are visible.
steps.notes: Use a test phone number not previously registered in the system.

steps.action: Tap 'Sign Up' or 'Create Account'. Enter the new retailer's phone number (e.g., +91-8888888888).
steps.expected: Phone number is accepted and formatted. A 'Send OTP' or 'Continue' button is enabled.

steps.action: Tap 'Send OTP'. Check WhatsApp on the device for the OTP message.
steps.expected: WhatsApp OTP message arrives within 30 seconds. OTP input screen appears in the app.

steps.action: Enter the received OTP and tap 'Verify'.
steps.expected: OTP is verified. App proceeds to the business setup / onboarding screen.

steps.action: Enter the required business details: Business Name: 'New Smoke Retailer', Business Type (select any available option), City: 'Bangalore'.
steps.expected: All fields accept the input. A 'Continue' or 'Finish Setup' button becomes active.

steps.action: Tap 'Continue' or 'Finish Setup'.
steps.expected: Onboarding completes. App navigates to the Dashboard. Business name 'New Smoke Retailer' is visible in the header or profile area.

steps.action: Close and reopen the app.
steps.expected: App reopens directly to the Dashboard without asking for login again. Session is persisted.

test_cases.title: Logout and session invalidation
test_cases.description: Verify the retailer can log out and the session is properly terminated.
test_cases.preconditions: Retailer is logged in.
test_cases.expected_result: Retailer is logged out and the app returns to the Login screen. Re-opening does not restore the session.

steps.action: Navigate to Settings or the profile/avatar menu.
steps.expected: Settings or Profile screen is visible.

steps.action: Tap 'Logout' or 'Sign Out'.
steps.expected: A confirmation dialog appears asking the retailer to confirm logout.

steps.action: Confirm the logout.
steps.expected: App navigates to the Login screen. The retailer's data is no longer visible.

steps.action: Close and reopen the app.
steps.expected: App opens to the Login screen (not the Dashboard). The previous session is not restored.
